asampāyanta.p: [Na+sampāyanta] (ti) CL=9 Cannot make perfect/complete; cannot answer completely- well; does not know; one.

K:
asampāyanta：အသမ္ပာယန္တ（တိ）
[န+သမ္ပာယန္တ]
